explanation: A touch makes cells at the base of each leaflet lose water fast, so the leaflets droop. The sudden collapse may startle grazing animals or shake off insects.

claims.text: The sensitive plant, Mimosa pudica, folds its leaflets within seconds when touched.
Aloe vera, spider plants and rubber plants do not fold their leaves when touched.
The leaflets fold when cells at their base rapidly lose water.
The folding may deter grazing animals or dislodge insects.
